User.title: User
User.description: A system user, either a doctor or an administrator.

uid.description: The unique user ID from authentication.

email.description: The email address of the user.

name.description: The full name of the user.

role.description: The system role of the user.

createdAt.description: The date and time the user profile was created.

Scan.title: Scan
Scan.description: An ultrasound scan record with prediction output and clinical metadata.

doctorId.description: The UID of the doctor who ran the scan.

doctorName.description: The name of the doctor who ran the scan.

imageUrl.description: URL of the uploaded scan image.

prediction.description: The diagnostic prediction of the machine learning model.

probabilities.description: The raw probability scores for each class.

timestamp.description: The date and time the scan was analyzed.

/scans/{scanId}.description: Collection of patient scan and prediction history.
